Quiz: The Baptism of Jesus Story Quiz
Question: What did the voice from heaven declare about Jesus?
OptionA: This is the prophet Moses promised
OptionB: This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased
OptionC: This is the king of Jerusalem
OptionD: This is my servant, listen to him
Explanation: A voice from heaven declared, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
